decision: accepted: C.3 design 7.1 user decision 5 (2026-11-10): use the capability matrix, subscription routes only
note: Only subscription-window routes are listed; dollar, API and gateway routes are added later, each after a live qualification with real costs. A route is `qualified` only when its model was observed working and its per-launch `demand` is justified by committed evidence; otherwise it is `unverified` with a fixed `reason`. Routes that draw on one provider usage pool name the same `pool` and `account`, so the collector reads one set of windows for them and their holds count together.
endpoint_rule: Gateway routes name their pinned OpenRouter endpoint in `endpoint`. The route identity (provider, model, effort, harness) has no endpoint yet, so two qualified routes with the same identity must name the same endpoint, or the whole manifest is refused (routing_observations.validate_routes).

reasons.demand_unjustified: No committed evidence bounds one launch's use of this pool's windows. The only measured readings bound tiny probe requests, not a worker launch (docs/smart-routing-capability-matrix.md, Route manifest).
reasons.model_unobserved: No committed evidence shows a model working on this route.
